activation: tanh hidden, linear output; score of an action = (1 if it is the rule action) + tanh(output)
rule: irrigate if the capped running water balance since 1 Nov exceeds p = 0.40 of the available water (FAO-56)
standardisation: mean and std over training rows only (scenario x priority x action); trained on the GPU, see meta.randomStreamNote in coffee_eval.json
